definitions.explanation: A strong desire to achieve something, especially regarding one's future career or education.

examples.english: His aspiration is to become a doctor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧⟦一→一：00705_ichi⟧{志望|しぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was accepted to my first-choice university.

examples.japanese: {志望|しぼう}⟦{動機|どうき}→動機：16028_douki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{聞|き}かれた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。「⟦なぜ→なぜ：01484_naze⟧⟦{当社|とうしゃ}→当社：22449_tousha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{志望|しぼう}したのですか」⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理念|りねん}→理念：06027_rinen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}びつけて→結び付ける：17205_musubitsukeru⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: I was asked about my motivation for applying in the interview. To the question "Why did you choose our company?", I answered by connecting my experience with the company's philosophy.

notes:
{志望|しぼう} refers to aspiration or ambition, often used for career goals or school choices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {志望|しぼう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to aspire to, to apply for)
- ⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧{志望|しぼう} (first choice)
- ⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{志望|しぼう} (second choice)
- ⟦{志望|しぼう}{校|こう}→志望校：18904_shiboukou⟧ (school of choice)
- {志望|しぼう}⟦{動機|どうき}→動機：16028_douki⟧ (motivation for applying)
- ⟦{志望|しぼう}{者|しゃ}→志望者：15174_shibousha⟧ (applicant, aspiring person)
- ○○{志望|しぼう} (aspiring to be XX): ⟦{医学部|いがくぶ}→医学部：27620_igakubu⟧{志望|しぼう} (aspiring to medical school), ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧{志望|しぼう} (aspiring writer)

NOTE: {志望|しぼう}, ⟦{死亡|しぼう}→死亡：03198_shibou⟧, and ⟦{脂肪|しぼう}→脂肪：03199_shibou⟧ are homophones. Context determines meaning.
